children: Foreign investors sold Chinese onshore yuan-denominated bonds in August, official data showed on Wednesday.

Foreign institutions held 3.19 trillion yuan ($475 billion) in bonds traded on China's interbank market as of the end of August, the central bank's Shanghai head office said, down from 3.21 trillion yuan a month earlier.
